## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: One coordinator request returns every pending gate across at least two...

The system SHALL ensure that one coordinator request returns every pending gate across at least two enrolled repositories, each with project, gate type, subject, options and deadline.

#### Scenario: One coordinator request returns every pending gate across at least two...

WHEN `add-project-keyed-gate-projection` is implemented
THEN One coordinator request returns every pending gate across at least two enrolled repositories, each with project, gate type, subject, options and deadline.

### Requirement: Deleting the projection and rebuilding it from the repositories yields the...

The system SHALL ensure that deleting the projection and rebuilding it from the repositories yields the same pending set.

#### Scenario: Deleting the projection and rebuilding it from the repositories yields the...

WHEN `add-project-keyed-gate-projection` is implemented
THEN Deleting the projection and rebuilding it from the repositories yields the same pending set.

### Requirement: A decision made through the listing reaches the owning repository's gate...

The system SHALL ensure that a decision made through the listing reaches the owning repository's gate record through the existing approval service, with no new decision store.

#### Scenario: A decision made through the listing reaches the owning repository's gate...

WHEN `add-project-keyed-gate-projection` is implemented
THEN A decision made through the listing reaches the owning repository's gate record through the existing approval service, with no new decision store.

### Requirement: A repository the coordinator cannot reach is reported as degraded, not...

The system SHALL ensure that a repository the coordinator cannot reach is reported as degraded, not silently omitted.

#### Scenario: A repository the coordinator cannot reach is reported as degraded, not...

WHEN `add-project-keyed-gate-projection` is implemented
THEN A repository the coordinator cannot reach is reported as degraded, not silently omitted.
